description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeReport class within the OrangeHRM Time module. It implements functionalities for generating employee time reports, including preparing filter parameters, validating request inputs, checking report access permissions, and defining report headers and filters. The class interacts with entity models like Project and ProjectActivity and utilizes various traits and API components for handling requests and translations.

classes.name: EmployeeReport
classes.description: Implements the report generation for employee time activities, including filter setup, validation, access control, and header definition. Utilizes traits for user role management and internationalization support.

methods.name: prepareFilterParams
methods.description: Prepares and populates the filter parameters for the report based on request query parameters, handling employee number, project and activity IDs, dates, and timesheet states.

methods.name: getValidationRule
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the request parameters, including checks for employee number, entity existence, date formats, date ranges, and allowed string values.

methods.name: checkReportAccessibility
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to read the employee report based on role permissions; throws ForbiddenException if access is denied.

methods.name: getHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Defines the report's header columns: Project Name, Activity Name, and Time (Hours), with internationalization support.

methods.name: getFilterDefinition
methods.description: Returns an empty filter definition, indicating no additional filter options.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Fetches and returns an EmployeeReportData object based on the supplied filter parameters.
